American media organizations with ties to the Trump campaign were involved in the spread of the false allegations.[25] Specifically Peter Schweizer,[68]John Solomon,[25]Fox News,[69] and One America News Network[70] were essential in creating and disseminating the lies that built the background for this conspiracy theory.

OANN produced a "documentary series intended to debunk the impeachment case", and an OANN crew traveled with Rudy Giuliani to Ukraine to gather information.[58] OANN later aired a misleading documentary about Biden and Burisma called "The Ukraine Hoax: Impeachment, Biden Cash, and Mass Murder"[84] produced by Michael Caputo,[83] a member of the Trump campaign, and Sergey Petrushin, a Russian living in Florida.

The documentary used fake documents provided to Giuliani by Parnas on behalf of Andrii Derkach and Konstantin Kilimnik.[69] Following Caputo's work in spreading the falsehoods through OANN, Donald Trump made Caputo the assistant secretary of public affairs for the Department of Health and Human Services.
